akd: akd and akd_core =0.13.0, ExperimentalConfiguration with domain label "sudo-v1 kt" (with 0x00 terminator)

epochs.what: alice recovers on a new phone

invalid.name: lookup-garbled
invalid.reason: one bit of the encoding changed

invalid.name: lookup-value-changed
invalid.reason: the value inside a well-formed proof changed

invalid.name: lookup-old-root
invalid.reason: epoch 3 proof against the epoch 2 root

invalid.name: lookup-prefix-lengthened
invalid.reason: the non-membership proof claims a longer common prefix than its children have

invalid.name: history-garbled
invalid.reason: one bit of the encoding changed

invalid.name: history-value-changed
invalid.reason: the newest value inside a well-formed proof changed

invalid.name: history-missing-version-1
invalid.reason: a new device asked for the complete history and got only version 2

invalid.name: history-skips-unchecked-version
invalid.reason: the device never checked version 1, so a history starting at version 2 hides it

invalid.name: history-version-repeated
invalid.reason: version 2 listed twice: versions must be consecutive

invalid.name: audit-garbled
invalid.reason: one bit of the encoding changed

invalid.name: audit-leaf-changed
invalid.reason: one inserted leaf inside a well-formed proof changed

invalid.name: audit-wrong-end-root
invalid.reason: epoch 1->2 proof against the epoch 3 root

invalid.name: audit-swapped-roots
invalid.reason: roots in the wrong order (the log shrank)

invalid.name: audit-wrong-start-root
invalid.reason: the end root is right but the start root is not (only the start check refuses it)

invalid.name: audit-wrong-epoch
invalid.reason: the proof claims the leaves were inserted one epoch later

notes: Labels are usernames (ASCII bytes); values are KtValue (kt-value.json). Proofs are akd_core's protobuf encoding (LookupProof, HistoryProof, AppendOnlyProof), hex.
lookups: verify with lookup_verify(vrf_public_key, root_hash, epoch, username, proof); the result must be 'value' and decode per §6.1.

histories: verify with key_history_verify(..., requested) where 'requested' is what the device asked for (never taken from the proof); then the oldest returned version must be at most last_checked_version + 1 (§6.3). 'versions' lists (epoch, version, value), newest first. An invalid history says who refuses it: 'akd' (key_history_verify fails), 'sudo-rule' (it passes, the §6.3 rule fails) or 'value' (both pass, a value fails §6.1).

audits: verify with audit_verify([from_root, to_root], proof). 'response' is the §10.14 answer to GET /v1/kt/audit/{epoch}: the epoch's SignedHead (120 bytes, here signed at its epoch_time) followed by the proof.
A lookup for a name that was never published ('dave') has no proof: the relay answers that the name is unknown.
vrf_seed is a fixed test key; a relay keeps its VRF key in the HSM/KMS (§6.1). akd derives its commitment key from the VRF private key.
